actual_tracking_issue.title: [AutoPerf F011] Group exclusion snapshot rejected: live-input semantics
actual_tracking_issue.body:
**Rejected/design-blocked for an unvalidated per-send exclusion snapshot. No shipping optimization or performance PR; not measured comparative no-gain.**

The real SignalR owner repeatedly scans excluded IDs. A real JsonHubProtocol-serialized argument getter can change the same array/List/read-only-wrapper backing input during first serialization: one of eight actual transports receives a frame. Explicit copied-input controls passed to the unchanged owner deliver to all eight. Custom ICollection.Contains comparison/dispatch differs too. These are native producer/input-semantics controls, not an implemented indexed owner or red/green optimization. Other compatible designs remain unverified.

[Immutable runnable project, complete evidence and limitations](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/ce4058291e633e5fec58e5faa988cfe04dcdc4a4/F011/README.md)

## Original-only diagnostics on this box

| Original shape | Mean ns | SD ns | Retained N | Process-wide B/op |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| NoGroup512 | 5.743 | 0.030 | 8 | 0 |
| OneEmpty | 261.840 | 7.243 | 8 | 248 |
| Small4List2 | 536.621 | 6.664 | 7 | 248 |
| G32List64 | 4584.769 | 11.693 | 8 | 248 |
| G32Array64 | 6882.311 | 22.042 | 7 | 248 |
| G32ReadOnly64 | 4971.806 | 11.482 | 7 | 248 |
| G128List256 | 41935.420 | 137.187 | 7 | 250 |
| G128Array256 | 80110.515 | 1242.382 | 7 | 252 |
| G32AllList | 2009.103 | 5.596 | 7 | 0 |
| G32AllArray | 3092.422 | 6.802 | 8 | 0 |
| G32HalfList | 2747.239 | 16.539 | 7 | 248 |
| G32DupList64 | 8741.924 | 45.681 | 6 | 248 |

One original-only 12-shape profile: 96 raw samples, 87 retained, nine upper-filtered, 36 warmups and 227 actual overheads. Zero candidate profiles/paired comparisons; closed budget, no additional F011 timing. Different configured inputs are not before/after roles. Allocation is process-wide, not isolated membership allocation.

Actual public group sends, real HubConnectionContext/JSON serialization, fixed 256-byte synchronous per-connection transport buffers. Connection creation, network, handshake, stateful reconnect and typical production traffic are not measured. Real Pipe backpressure/completion/cancellation are characterized separately, untimed.

## Coverage and provenance

All 27 discovered DefaultHubLifetimeManagerTests rows pass: 23 Facts including 12 inherited specification Facts, plus four actual Theory payloads; not the whole SignalR project. All 17 real producer checks and 12 timed-wrapper paths pass with both original and actual captured-default JSON source. Only JSON DLL/PDB differ between the 80-file images; original repository outputs were restored byte-exact. This is not whole-current-default SDK/dependency integration.

Independent live and copied portable audits pass: 34 producer/36 setup/36 delivery records, 19 bounded PE/PDB bindings, 52 selected document checks, 178 source snapshots and 24 unchanged host-settings point records. Portable mode cannot rehash omitted binaries or independently replay PE/PDB bindings. Both failed prelaunch readers and every raw timing/GC observation remain.

Exact historical commands with observed exits: https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/ce4058291e633e5fec58e5faa988cfe04dcdc4a4/F011/validation-commands.md

Independent unchanged source branch: https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/autoperf/F011-signalr-group-exclusions, baseline `37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5`. Actual remote source ref and owner bytes verified.

Related David Fowler work dotnet/aspnetcore#69189 changes small-target SendConnectionsAsync, not SendGroupExceptAsync; no upstream numbers reused. F012/F013/F014 remain independent.

Shared Windows VM, SDK12.0.100-alpha.1.26557.102/runtime12.0.0-alpha.1.26562.105, settings-preserving executor; no deliberate power/priority/affinity changes or isolated-machine/general application-speedup claim.
